title: Camping in the Mountains
paragraphs: Belum pernah berkemah sebelumnya, Yasir setuju bergabung dengan dua temannya untuk perjalanan akhir pekan ke pegunungan, diam-diam khawatir ia akan sama sekali tidak berguna saat mendirikan tenda. Percobaan pertama mendirikan tenda memakan waktu hampir satu jam dan menghasilkan struktur yang runtuh dua kali sebelum akhirnya berdiri tegak, membuat teman-temannya yang lebih berpengalaman geli.

Malam itu, berbaring di luar di bawah langit penuh bintang yang jarang ia perhatikan di kota, Yasir merasakan penghargaan tenang atas kesederhanaan pengalaman itu meski ada perjuangan sebelumnya. Menjelang akhir perjalanan, ia sudah belajar cukup untuk mendirikan tenda sendiri, dan yang lebih penting, ia menemukan bahwa sesekali keluar dari zona nyamannya membawa kepuasan nyata dan bertahan lama.
answerKey: Never having camped before, Yasir agreed to join two friends on a weekend trip to the mountains, secretly worried he would be completely useless when it came to setting up a tent. The first attempt at pitching the tent took nearly an hour and resulted in a structure that collapsed twice before finally staying upright, much to the amusement of his more experienced friends. That night, lying outside under a sky full of stars he rarely noticed in the city, Yasir felt a quiet appreciation for the simplicity of the experience despite the earlier struggles. By the end of the trip, he had learned enough to set up the tent alone, and more importantly, he had discovered that stepping outside his comfort zone occasionally brought real, lasting satisfaction.
